name: claude-toolbox
description: Personal Claude Code plugins: mods and skills.

plugins.name: usage-bars
plugins.description: Always-visible context, 5-hour and weekly usage bars above the prompt, with the active model on the right.

plugins.name: ledger
plugins.description: A numbered side-panel ledger of decisions, bugs, gaps and smells found during a session, nested as a tree with progress, notes and folding, and auto-saved; refer to items as "13 (ledger)", export them with a briefing, import or merge them in another session, and pull or sync GitHub issues.

plugins.name: session-name
plugins.description: Shows the active session's name in the status line, kept current as it is generated or renamed.
